review.review: The hero was alive at the terminal planner failure. The final mandatory obligation was an iron key behind magical fire, despite the generic upgrade/strength error wording. The initiating contradiction appeared earlier: after identifying frost, decisions 507–509 approached a throwing bank, but decision 510 yielded to exploration as soon as fire became visible. Decisions 511–512 repeated the reversal. Known-frost preparation excluded visible fire, while general preparation yielded to the cached food target; neither selected the existing guarded throw. Later the matching-key obligation correctly blocked descent. Source and all saved log records resolve this arbitration gap. A reduced public-evidence regression fails on original policy and passes with a focused visible-arrival handoff; the full suite passes 2,273 tests with four skips. This establishes selection, not extinguishing, collection, or survival.
